text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Dorm Head!
Good night!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Good night!
Don't oversleep, alright?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
......Now then.
—Just 15 minutes until 22:00, huh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haaah... phew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
My, what a bad dorm leader.
Curfew has already passed, you know.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? Ramonu-senpai!?
Why are you—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Rest assured. I am an accomplice as well.
As long as you do not blame me,
I too shall keep my lips sealed."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Well, how about it?
You can't cool that heat down by yourself, can you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Then would you mind joining me for a lap?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Of course.

The "Spring Fan Appreciation Festival," where Umamusume celebrate together with their fans!
This year, Rhein Kraft took part in—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Entry number 3 in the Youth Shouting Contest!
Our next Umamusume is—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'm Rhein Kraft!

text_block_list.name: Nearby Fans
text_block_list.text:
Way to go~! Rhein Kraft-t!
We're expecting big words from you~!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mm-mm! Full marks, double circle!
Let's project our voices from the belly!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!!
It was a few weeks before the Spring Fan Thanksgiving Festival.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I think
I should put myself out there more.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
People often say it, don't they?
If you have a dream you want to make come true,
you shouldn't keep it a secret; you should keep talking about it.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
So please watch me!
I'm gonna leave my mark on the Fan Thanksgiving Festival too!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Phew... inhale...——Ghk.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(—Back straight.
Loud and clear from the very first word. Show some real presence.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (As a Tiara Umamusume running in the present—!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I, Rhein Kraft—
Looooove Tiara Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I've gained so much from watching the Tiara Umamusume races!
Courage, the power to believe in myself, and the will to never give up!"

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it's Rhein Kraft! She's totally the face of the Tiara right now!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Ugh, if only Cesario wasn't on break... Everyone's just hyping up Craft non-stop.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Besides—
the lineage of Tiara Umamusume is simply captivating!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: That's why I want to follow in our seniors' footsteps too! As a continuation of the legacy the Tiara Umamusume built!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I want to create the greatest race with my own legs!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, as motivated as ever~
Honestly, you're the absolute, rock-solid favorite, though.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Full of thrill, full of suspense.
I'll deliver a race that keeps eyes glued until the very end with these legs of mine!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. The suspense is too much for me~.
Make sure you take 1st place next time too!
I'm looking forward to that big record~.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The radiance of the girls from the Triple Tiara route,
shining just as brilliantly as the Classic Triple Crown—

text_block_list.name: Fan E
text_block_list.text: Ah. Come to think of it, this year's Hero is taking on the Senior royal road! Both the Tenno Sho (Spring) and the Takarazuka Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Fan F
text_block_list.text:
Ehhhh! Insane, I gotta go watch!!
I wonder what kind of legend she'll create this time~?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...,
âââNnnngh!!" subcommittee="true

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I will too! As a Tiara Umamusume!!
I'll deliver our radiance to everyone, no matter whatttt!!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, ...*cough*.
—...Phew, huff...

text_block_list.name: Fan at the Fan Thanksgiving
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, I hope the Hero has an amazing year this year too~!
Woah~! A Derby Umamusume Cafe!
Now where's the 'Tenno Sho (Spring)' special feature...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mmh!! What a splendid shout!!
That was youth at its absolute finest!

text_block_list.name: Nearby Fans
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Well said!
I'll be cheering for you at the Victoria Mile too!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you all for listening.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Alright, guess it's my turn next――

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Hishiama-san?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Craft!
This is how you work the mic!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Everyone, stop in your tracks!!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Hishi Amazon?!
What a throwback! She's the girl who raced Naribu!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"That's right!
I am the "Empress" Hishi Amazon, conqueror of the Queen Elizabeth II Commemorative Cup, who dared to challenge the Triple Tiara!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"So, do you guys know that horse girl from earlier...
Rhein Kraft?"

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: I know~ She's super strong, that girl~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —So, if you went up against the "Heroine", who would win?

text_block_list.name: Nearby Fans
text_block_list.text: —Kh!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Try picturing it.
Me and that star of the Tiara you're all rooting for,
duking it out neck-and-neck right before the goal line."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Between me, who pushed the "strongest" Narita Brian to her limits,
and Craft, who do you think would win?

text_block_list.name: Nearby Fans
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur, murmur, murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Nearby Fans
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm backing Craft all the way!
Huh, Hishi Ama is gonna win, obviously!?
I mean, depending on the distance—...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Then what if it were a sprint against me?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Between me, who conquered the world,
and her, who strove to be the fastest of her generation..."

text_block_list.name: Nearby Fans
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, no way, Seeking the Pearl is coming too?!
I watched it live! The moment she conquered the European G1!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Ah, that's right.
Come, queens of the past.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ――You guys have your pride too, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaah~~!?
Lady Ramonu~~!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh, you as well?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Since I was invited, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"No way, no way, no way! Those two are returning to the front line too!?
The 'Undefeated Triple Crown' Queen, and the young lady of the 'Splendid Clan'!?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "I shall show my greatest radiance at the Sprinters Stakes."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Then I shall head for the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wah, I'm aiming for!
The Yasuda Kinen and
the Sprinters Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Me too!
This time, the Takarazuka Kinen will be mine.
And after that, I'm taking the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be running in the Yasuda Kinen, Takarazuka Kinen, and Queen Elizabeth II Cup.
And then, the Mile Championship."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Mhm-mhm♪ Next up is me—

text_block_list.name: SP
text_block_list.text:
Lady Fine!?
If you are to continue racing past three years,
we must receive permission from your father as well...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I received it.
Therefore, I would like to run in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I'm heading for the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.
...Though I'll run in a graded race beforehand."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Hishi Ama.
While we're at it... wanna test whether the 'Empress' or the 'Amazon' is on top?"
(Oooh... Uoooohhh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
G-Goodness!
What on earth is this gathering all about!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (...So cool.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(They completely turned the atmosphere around.
What I couldn't do,
the seniors—)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
“—I fell in love with it, you know.
With her back.”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Craft. We looked at your back and
thought you were seriously cool."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Aha...! You really pull through when it counts, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Right then. Craft,
I'm not gonna let you take all the glory!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Thinking you alone can carry the Tiara route
is ten thousand years too early for you!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, ooooohhh!?
This is the biggest hype of the entire tournament!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (—Tiara Umamusume really are amazing.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(The one I have to face—
the one I have to surpass—is that back in front of me.)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Craft, what's your answer?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah, um—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I won't lose to my seniors either!
I'm going to run the best race of the year!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Heh... Come at me.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (――Like a dream.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (――It feels like a dream!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Cesario-san.
Where is Craft-san—oh.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
She's been sleeping like a log for a while now.
She won't wake up at all, even if I shake her.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Maybe she wore herself out from being so excited.
After all, this announcement made her immensely happy.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Um, do you have a message for Craft?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No. Not particularly.
It's just――

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "—I just came to tell you that I'm looking forward to this upcoming year even more now."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
We are going in at our absolute best to take the win.
Do you understand what that means?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh, um—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —From this point on, we're not your seniors anymore.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: My "rival."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...By all means. Thank you very much.

Just then, a massive cheer echoed throughout the academy.
As if celebrating the scorching season about to begin—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (――Like a dream.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (――It feels like a dream!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Cesario-san.
Where is Craft-san—oh.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
She's been sleeping like a log for a while now.
She won't wake up at all, even if I shake her.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Maybe she wore herself out from being so excited.
After all, this announcement made her immensely happy.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Um, do you have a message for Craft?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No. Not particularly.
It's just――

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "—I just came to tell you that I'm looking forward to this upcoming year even more now."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Is that so?
